description: Record decisions for a reconciliation run (write — admin role). REPLACES the run's planned actions, so send the complete list. Each deprecated entity gets migrate, retain or retire_only.

actions.description: The complete set of planned actions for this run — partial lists overwrite the rest

action.description: migrate: move to a successor; retain: keep the deprecated entity scoped; retire_only: drop it

entity.description: Entity type the key refers to (default 'controls')

justification.description: Why this decision was taken — recorded for audit

key.description: Identifier of the deprecated entity this decision is about, as given in the run detail

successor_scf_id.description: Successor control identifier — required by apply when action is 'migrate'

confirmed_framework_ids.description: On a first reconciliation, the confirmed framework list this organization is scoping to

run_id.description: Reconciliation run UUID — obtain from scf_list_reconciliation_runs or scf_preview_catalog_reconciliation

name: scf_set_reconciliation_actions
